3. After buying a ticket, you will receive it through the app. Please ensure you enable notifications, which will inform you of any updates to your ticket such as seat assignments or confirmation of the match date and time.
4. Nominalize your ticket by entering your name and surname through the app.
5. Your ticket will only become active on match day. To enter the stadium, simply show your purchased ticket on the app from your mobile phone.
6. A few hours before the game, a QR code will appear at the entrance, which you can use to access the stadium, provided you have entered your name through the app.



We are thrilled to offer this seamless, secure, and digital ticketing experience through our app. Thank you for choosing the FC Barcelona Tickets App.
